annotations.title: Enable auto-publish for an issue type

description: Patches: from now on, a freshly AI-drafted patch for this issue type publishes immediately instead of waiting for a manual publish_patch call — capped at 20 auto-publishes per project per day. A hand-typed replacement value (draft_patch's `value` argument) is NEVER auto-published regardless of this rule. FREE (no credits), but this is a MUTATION. Requires an org admin.

issueType.description: Which finding type to auto-publish AI-drafted patches for.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: enable_patch_auto_publish
